patterns.note: The hero section prominently features a large, detailed product UI screenshot, immediately showcasing the application's interface rather than abstract graphics.
Feature sections utilize a two-column layout, pairing descriptive text on the left with corresponding code examples on the right to cater to a technical audience.
A consistent palette of white, black, and a light blue gradient for the hero background creates a clean, professional, and functional aesthetic.
The primary navigation bar remains fixed at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls down the page, ensuring constant access to navigation links.
Headings are set in a clear, modern sans-serif font, with the hero heading being significantly larger and bolder to establish immediate visual hierarchy and impact.

technique_notes: A sticky header navigation bar is implemented, maintaining access to key links and branding as the user scrolls through the page content.

The hero section is designed to immediately present the product's core functionality by embedding a large, realistic screenshot of the application's user interface, allowing users to quickly grasp what the product does.
Content sections are structured with a split layout, presenting feature benefits and descriptions alongside relevant code snippets to effectively communicate technical details and usage examples.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold hero heading (~3-4x body) with clear, readable body text and smaller, uppercase labels for feature categories.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners (approx 4-8px) on buttons, input fields, card-like elements, and the main product screenshot frame.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between main content sections and a more compact layout within feature descriptions and code blocks.

standout: The site immediately distinguishes itself by placing a large, detailed, and realistic product UI screenshot directly in the hero section, effectively demonstrating the application's functionality without relying on abstract imagery or lengthy explanations. This direct visual communication, combined with the concise 'Open Source backend in 1 file' tagline, makes the product's value proposition instantly clear to a technical audience.
